behaviorChange: Two defect fixes, no signature or budget changes. (1) At a C0 knot the two-sided jet no longer decides alone: endpoint and corner tangency screens accept either transverse one-sided span jet, and the Newton refiners step with the came-from side's jet and re-screen converged C0 roots one-sidedly — transverse kink roots that previously became tangency_or_multiple_root/near_coincidence bands now resolve as point events, while roots tangent from both sides stay unresolved. (2) Box-boundary ownership is now half-open and documented: a converged Newton image within two binary64 steps of a shared face snaps onto it bitwise and only the owning box (interior + lower face, domain upper end in the last box) reports it; curve/plane zero-variation and terminal boxes evaluate shared faces exactly (zero-variation faces only where the face coefficient's own bound cannot exclude zero) and the owning box reports at the exact parameter; curve/plane point events with touching isolating intervals merge keeping the lowest-residual parameter, mirroring the long-standing curve/curve rule. Side effects: a rounding-scale transverse near-pass exactly on a shared face can now report a contact point with its true residual instead of a near_coincidence band, and a converged C0-knot root that is tangent from both sides now fails its box explicitly instead of skipping the re-screen. No existing test encoded the defective behavior, so no test was weakened; three of the eight new fixtures also pass pre-fix and act as guards

limits.boxOwnership: half-open: each subdivision box owns its interior and its lower-parameter face; the domain's upper end is owned by the last box; exactly one box owns any parameter
limits.faceSnap: a converged Newton parameter within two binary64 next_up/next_down steps of a box face resolves to the face bitwise — rounding reconciliation at a bitwise shared face, not a spatial tolerance and never a merge of distinct parameters
limits.oneSidedJets: left/right first derivatives from the adjacent Bézier spans via exact knot-insertion trims; the came-from side is preferred in Newton steps, either confirming side is accepted; converged C0 roots resolve when any side combination is transverse and stay unresolved when none is
limits.curvePlaneFaces: zero-variation boxes confirm a shared face only when its endpoint coefficient bound contains zero and the exact evaluation is within distance tolerance and the box-side one-sided jet is transverse; terminal boxes report the midpoint candidate unless a face's residual is not beaten by it; touching-interval point events merge keeping the lowest-residual parameter
limits.dedup: exact parameters only; no spatial-tolerance merging and no tolerance growth anywhere

limitations: Only ruled surfaces are admitted for curve/surface; general CS against arbitrary NURBS surfaces, analytic SS pairs, certified tangency and partial ruling trims remain open (unchanged from the previous slice)

Newton images that leave their box by more than the two-step face-snap window still stay silent outside and trust the neighboring box; a pathological rounding disagreement wider than two ulp at a shared face could still leave a boundary root silent
A rounding-scale transverse near-pass whose closest point lands bitwise on a shared face can now be reported as a contact point with its true residual instead of a near_coincidence band

The dyadic curve/curve and curve/ruled-surface boundary fixtures pass on the pre-fix behavior as well; the pre-fix failure for those queries was a latent one-ulp window and is guarded rather than reproduced deterministically
